The Whole List

What You Actually Need

Less than you’d think. Three things, and you probably have one of them already.

1

A computer you can leave on

Your agent answers while Archie is running, so you want a computer you don’t mind leaving on. Already have one? Use it. A laptop just needs to not fall asleep, and we’ll sort that with you. If you’d rather have a computer that’s always ready and never in your way, a Mac mini is the easy answer: inexpensive, silent, and happy to run around the clock.

Archie runs on both Mac and Windows, and both are in testing: join the waitlist and we’ll tell you the day it lands.

2

An account with an AI company

Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Google (Gemini), Groq or xAI (Grok), pay-as-you-go. Groq is free to start and needs no card, and Google is free in most countries. You pay for what your agent actually does: around $4.40 a month for a handful of tasks a day, more if you lean on it constantly. Here’s that worked out for three levels of use. It’s billed straight to you and you can cap it. We never touch it and we never see it.

Archie itself is $149 a year or $19 a month when it ships, a separate cost from guided setup. Every cost, in full.

3

A chat app, to be reached anywhere

Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal or Matrix. You can talk to your agent inside Archie itself, on the computer it runs on, so this is not something to sort out before you start. It is what lets your agent reach you when you are not at that computer: your agent lives in the app like a contact, and the conversation is the same one either way, so you can write from your desk and carry on from your phone. Telegram is the quickest to set up and the one most people choose.

WhatsApp and iMessage are the two people ask for, and neither one lets an app like this answer on your behalf. That is their rule, not our choice.

4

An Otian account, and a plan

Archie asks you to sign in when it opens, and a browser window handles it. A plan is $149 a year or $19 a month, and you can change or stop it whenever you like. That account is the only one on our side, and what it holds is your email address, whether you have a current plan, and any paid add-ons you have bought. Never a conversation.

This is the same cost named above, listed here because it is a thing you need, not only a thing you pay. Every cost, in full.

That’s the whole list.

Not sure what to get? Bring it to the free call, and we’ll tell you exactly what you need, and nothing you don’t.
